main_text.p: masc. Ramus summus, Jesa.17.6. Apud Rabbinos אֲמִירֵי תְאֵנִים Rami ficuum.
אָמְרָה f. Sermo. Constr. אִמְרַת Psalm.105.v.19. Aff. אִמְרָתוֹ Verbum ejus, Psal.147.15. & semel אִמְרָתוֹ Thren. 2.17. Plural. אִמְרוֹת, & Constr. אִמְרוֹת Dicta, Eloqua, Psal.12.7.
מֵאֲמָר m. Sermo, Oratio, Edictum, Esth.1.15. Chald. וּמִנִּמְאֲמָר Ex (ex) sermone, Dan.4.14. כִּמְאמָר Secundum edictum, Esr.6.9.
אַמְרָא m. Chald. Agnus, in Targum frequens: Plur. אַמְרִין Agni, Esr.6.9.17.
אֶמֶשׁ Hesternâ, Præteritâ nocte vel vesperâ, Heri vesperi, Genes.19.34.
* אַמְתָּנִי Nomen Chald. vide suprà in אִיִּם [?].
אַן Quò? 1.Sam.10. v.14. Loci & temporis est: עַד־אַן Quousque? de tempore, Job.8.2. מֵאַן De quo, id est, Undenam? 2.Reg.5.25. quod legitur מֵאַיִן , ut Gen.29. v.4. & alibi.

אָנָה Quò, Psal.139.7. & Deut.1.28. quibus duobus locis est Milra; aliàs semper Milhel seu penacutum, ut Masore-thæ notant: & Nun est cum Dagesch: אָנָּה תֹלֵךְ Quò abis, Jud.19.17. אָנָּה וְאָנָה Huc aut illuc, 1.Reg.2.36. עַד־אָנָה Usquequò? Psalm.13.2. Item אָנָּא Quæsò, obsecrò, Psalm.116. v.4. & sic sexies per ה scribitur; aliàs אָנָּא Genes.50.17.
אָנֵּן Chald. Illi, Isti, Dan.2.44. Fœmin. אָנִּין Isti, ea ea, Dan.7.v.17. Nun in fine ad terminationem pluralem pertinet.
* אֲנִבָּא Nomen Chaldaicum, vide in אבב.
אָנָה Mœstus fuit, Luxit: Præter. וְאָנוּ Et mœrebunt, Jesa.3.26. Pih. אִנָּה Obvenire, occurrere fecit, Causam vel Occasionem præbuit veniendi, id est, Objecit,

page.notes: Hebrew words are transcribed from the scan; vowel points and some letters are hard to read at this resolution, so doubtful forms are marked [?]. The entry "אָמְרָה" was read with an uncertain initial vowel. The entry with "אִיִּם" and the entry with "אֲנִבָּא" are doubtful. Printed typographic irregularities (e.g. "Eloqua,", "ea ea", "Quò" with accent) are left as printed. Long s is normalised to s throughout.
